title: GameEvent
description: Envelope shared by every event (spec §2). Append-only. Ordering: (wallClock, deviceId, seq).

corrects.description: id of the event this supersedes (§6)

effectiveAfter.description: id of the event this logically follows, when recorded later than it happened (§6 insert) — e.g. a stolen base noticed two pitches late. Projections fold in this logical order, not recording order.
